scenarios.name: Status quo
scenarios.description: No new AI-specific policy lever. Counterfactual against which other scenarios are measured.
assumptions: Natural dynamics evolve under existing conditions
caveats: Required as the like-for-like baseline in every comparison

scenarios.name: Aggregate policy
scenarios.description: Single policy intensity applied uniformly across all 19 sectors (equal per-sector allocation).
assumptions: Equal per-sector allocation Delta / n where n = 19
Baseline intensity matched to other scenarios
caveats: Comparable to targeted scenarios under the same total envelope

scenarios.name: Targeted demand-side
scenarios.description: Support weighted toward sectors with the largest adoption gap (1 - A_s(0)).
assumptions: Weights w_s = (1 - A_s(0)) normalised to sum 1
Direct support concentrated on demand-limited sectors
caveats: Targeting rule is observable and reproducible from initial conditions
Does not adjust as adoption evolves within the run

scenarios.name: Targeted supply-side
scenarios.description: All policy investment goes to the national enabling stock E. No direct sector subsidy.
caveats: Slower onset; broader reach across all 19 sectors

scenarios.name: Mixed targeted (B + C)
scenarios.description: Half-intensity demand-side targeting plus half-intensity supply-side targeting under the same envelope.
assumptions: Half of Delta allocated by adoption-gap weights (G_s)
Half of Delta added to G_E
Same total envelope as other scenarios
caveats: Tests whether hybrid targeting beats pure targeting
